cuts.item: Reserve/desk coverage 3 to 7 line zeroed out to fund the lieutenant
Level-services school scenario drops ESSER positions
Town manager preliminary school budget drops positions

statements.statement: Police chief said the department's FY25 increase is 2.87%, not the 5.94% shown, once the patrol contract raise is counted.
Town manager's preliminary school budget is around 3%, about $684,000 more than last year.
Superintendent's budget is a 5.42% increase, about $565,000 over the town manager's figure.
Level services minus the ESSER positions is an 8.73% increase, about 1323 million over the preliminary budget.
Level service with all FY24 positions is an 11.46% increase, $1.95 million over the preliminary budget; it drew no support.
School committee voted 4 to 1 to support an override but did not choose among budgets.
Members used a 3.25 million override on a 325 million levy as an illustration of about a 10% tax increase.

warnings.condition: if budget held to a 2.5% ceiling
warnings.prediction: At a 2.5% ceiling budget the hiring plan would be suspended, the school resource officer, co-response, community programs reduced and desk hours cut.

warnings.condition: if the town manager's figure is presented
warnings.prediction: School committee members would likely vote down the town manager's budget if presented to them.

warning: EXTRACTED BY A LANGUAGE MODEL FROM MACHINE CAPTIONS. Every figure is as heard and may be misheard; every line carries the second in the video, which is the record.
